record.body:
## Evidence

Dashboard processes are supposed to open the store with `adaptive_artifacts.project.open_store`, and the orchestra dependency on adaptive-artifacts is supposed to cover that process. `dashboard/bin/dashboard` and `dashboard/bin/web` exec `uv run --script` on `dashboard/__main__.py` and `dashboard/web/__main__.py`. Those scripts declare only textual, or fastapi/uvicorn/textual. The uv environments do not contain `adaptive_artifacts`, while the modules they launch import it at startup.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Create a fix work-item under the retry budget.
